'''Tors Remal''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] during the time [[Natasi Daala]] was [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. He remained loyal to [[Natasi Daala|Daala]], even though she was defeated many times.
